description: This Kotlin file contains data classes, enums, and functions related to resolving and parsing gateway endpoint configurations for an Android application. It manages gateway URLs, security verification, setup codes, and connection configurations.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration details of a gateway endpoint such as host, port, TLS usage, and display URL.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Encapsulates a setup code containing URL and optional security tokens or password.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Holds the connection configuration including host, port, security, and authentication tokens.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible validation errors for gateway endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enumerates sources of gateway endpoint input such as setup code, manual entry, or QR scan.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Result of parsing a gateway endpoint, containing either a config or an error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Result of scanning a setup code, either returning a setup code or an error.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Builds a GatewayConnectConfig object based on setup code or manual input parameters.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a raw input string into a GatewayEndpointConfig if valid.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Parses a raw URL string to produce parsing result with config or error.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded JSON string into a GatewaySetupCode object.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Resolves a setup code scanned from QR or other sources into a string.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Resolves a scanned setup code into a structured result with error handling.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly validation message based on error type and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Constructs a manual gateway URL from host, port, and TLS indicator.
